Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("hidden_content" = "reachable"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
